scope: Static design check before reviewer execution; no central code authored.
denominator_check: Total outflows less actual source floor and grown pillar/admin yields healthcare plus federal operations. The trigger then adds current floor plus base pillar/admin, matching the source. Direct ten-year components and source-floor reproduction guard against reconstruction errors.
other_checks: 60 aggregate policy-year rows,30 paired-year summaries,60000 source path-years and120000 policy outcomes are consistent with design.
Source seeds alone do not pair cohorts; within-cohort paired policies are correctly specified.
Annual reset, sequential strict tests, upper-middle percentile and annual positive-gap probability preserved.
limit: This is protocol feasibility, not result validation.
